settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• Individuals experiencing sagging skin or fine lines around the jowl and jawline area.
  • Users of MyoLift™ devices seeking a hands-free microcurrent treatment.
  • Those preferring a no-mess, conductive gel-free solution for facial toning.
  • Anyone desiring a more defined jawline and improved skin elasticity.

settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
1. Cleanse and dry your face to ensure optimal adhesion and conductivity.
  2. Apply a water-based serum or spritz with Replenish Spritzer if your skin is dry. Avoid using oil-based products as they can impede the flow of current.
  3. Peel off the plastic backing from the Jowl Mask.
  4. Connect the mask to your MyoLift™ device using the lead wire.
  5. Place the mask over your jowl and jawline area, ensuring full contact with the skin.
  6. Select the desired settings on your device:
    Use Level 1 Erase for 10–30 minutes.
    Use Level 1 Educate for half the duration.
  7. Relax during the treatment, allowing the microcurrent to stimulate and tone the area.
  8. After treatment, remove the mask and store it on its plastic backing for future use. Each mask is reusable for 10–15 treatments.
  9. Clean the mask if necessary using isopropyl alcohol and a soft cloth. Avoid using abrasive materials that could damage the conductive surface.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Reduces the Appearance of Sagging Skin: Targets the jowl and jawline area for a more defined contour.
  • Stimulates Collagen Production: Enhances skin elasticity and firmness.
  • Improves Skin Tone and Texture: Promotes a smoother and more youthful complexion.
  • Convenient and Easy to Use: No messy gels or creams required.
  • Cost-Effective: Reusable design offers multiple treatments per mask.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Hands-Free Design: Allows for multitasking during treatment sessions.
  • Self-Adhesive Backing: No need for conductive gels or creams.
  • Reusable: Each mask can be used for 10–15 treatments with proper care.
  • Compatible with MyoLift™ Devices: Works seamlessly with all MyoLift™ models.
  • Portable and Convenient: Ideal for home use or travel.
